key_terms: A contiguous memory region holding one part of an Arrow array, such as its fixed-width values or its validity bits.
A buffer with one bit per slot in which a set bit marks a present value, so nulls need no sentinel. Its logical size is n divided by 8, rounded up, bytes for n slots.
The starting slot of an array within its buffers. With offset o and value width w, logical element i starts at byte (o + i) times w.
A new array view that reuses its parent's buffers with a different offset and length instead of copying values.

worked_examples.title: Read the validity bitmap behind a null
worked_examples.code:
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.compute as pc

values = pa.array([10, None, 30, 40], type=pa.int64())
validity = values.buffers()[0].to_pybytes()[0]
print([(validity >> i) & 1 for i in range(4)])
print(pc.mean(values).as_py(), pc.mean(pc.fill_null(values, 0)).as_py())
worked_examples.interpretation: Bit 1 is zero, so the second slot is missing even though the payload buffer still holds some integer there. The observed mean divides 80 by three known values, while the zero-filled mean divides by four and reports 20. Neither is wrong in general; the question is whether a missing reading means no measurement or a real zero, and that decision belongs in the contract rather than in a default fill.

worked_examples.title: Confirm a slice shares memory with its parent
worked_examples.code:
import pyarrow as pa

values = pa.array([10, None, 30, 40], type=pa.int64())
sliced = values.slice(1, 2)
print(sliced.offset, len(sliced), sliced.to_pylist())
print(sliced.buffers()[1].address == values.buffers()[1].address)
worked_examples.interpretation: The slice reports offset 1 and length 2 and points at the same payload address as the parent, so slicing copied nothing. That is efficient, but it also means a tiny slice can keep a large parent buffer alive in memory. When memory use stays high after filtering a big batch down to a few rows, check for retained slices and copy them with take or concat if the parent should be released.
